Definition: Adah, the name of two women
BiblicalUsage: The name Adah belongs to two women: Adah, wife of Lamech and mother of Jabal and Jubal, and Adah, daughter of Elon the Hittite, one of Esau's wives.
TheologicalSignificance: The first Adah's family invented music and the wandering life; the second Adah's marriage grieved Isaac and Rebekah. I hold both as a sober picture: the line of Cain grew clever and godless at once, and Esau's choices cost his parents dear.
RelatedPeople: Adah, Wife of Lamech; Adah, Wife of Esau; Lamech, Father of Noah; Esau
